quarterly_data.signal: HPE's 10-Q: unconditional purchase obligations, including long-term agreements, were approximately $30.4 billion as of July 31, 2026, related principally to inventory purchases, software maintenance and support services and other items; HPE expects them to total $4.2 billion in fiscal 2026, $11.6 billion in fiscal 2027, $4.4 billion in fiscal 2028, $4.2 billion in fiscal 2029, $4.0 billion in fiscal 2030 and $2.0 billion thereafter. Days payable outstanding rose versus the year-ago quarter primarily due to higher purchases to secure strategic component supply and fulfill backlog.
quarterly_data.figure: unconditional purchase obligations ~$30.4 billion (July 31, 2026): $4.2 billion fiscal 2026, $11.6 billion fiscal 2027, $4.4 billion fiscal 2028, $4.2 billion fiscal 2029, $4.0 billion fiscal 2030, $2.0 billion thereafter

connects_to.relationship: HPE Juniper networking routers and switches for Oracle's gigawatt-scale AI cloud build-out

contracts.signal: HPE's 10-Q discloses that Oracle Corp. entered into a strategic collaboration with HPE to deploy HPE networking solutions in Oracle's AI data centers. In connection with it, HPE issued Oracle a warrant on July 2, 2026 that vests in tranches as Oracle and its affiliates reach specific milestones for purchases of HPE products and support.
contracts.type: strategic collaboration (warrant vesting on purchase milestones)
